purpose: Test whether localizing negative policy updates helps beyond uniformly weakening them
budget_basis: Equal new optimizer steps and question order; actual generated tokens and PRM scoring cost recorded separately
sampling: One shared, validated native-LoRA runtime for all variants; no per-arm runtime changes
sampling_runtime_gate: Full generation/reward/token-signal/loss integration and adapter synchronization validation
evaluation: Same V1 native-LoRA greedy protocol, unchanged prompts and reward-repair-v3 verifier, 2048-token cap
interpretation: Prefix versus uniform tests localization; prefix versus bounded alone cannot distinguish localization from weaker negative updates
limitations: Approximately 7M cumulative generation tokens, not a from-scratch 6M comparison
Validation has previously been used; not a pristine held-out test
PRM low score is not ground-truth first error
